system.description:
Target's [Fatigue] is reduced by -10, and additionally [Cancel (Poison, Mind):10] is applied. The dish served by the warrior maid to the warriors facing a great battle. It is said to heighten combat spirit and strengthen body and mind, but due to its surprisingly terrible taste, its reputation is poor.

Bitter Liver [Core Material] (180G) + Master Topoto's Croquette (90G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 9] (90G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (290G)
